content.text:
I added the tooltip to the "?" icon next to "Due date". It shows "Tasks are due at 6 pm in your local time." when you hover over the icon or tab to it, and sits above the icon by default. I haven't opened the page in a browser, so none of this has been checked on screen yet.

- **`index.html`**: I moved the "?" icon out of the `<label>` into a new `.label-row` next to it, and added the tooltip text right after the icon. The icon is linked to the tooltip so screen readers read the text when the icon gets focus. I moved it because otherwise the "?" and the tooltip text would become part of the date field's spoken name ("Due date ? Tasks are due…").
- **`style.css`**: Added the tooltip styles: a dark box with a small arrow pointing at the icon, a version for when it flips below, a focus ring on the icon, and flex layout for the label row. The tooltip extends to the right of the icon rather than being centered on it, so it doesn't run off the left edge of narrow phone screens.
- **`app.js`**: Shows the tooltip on mouse hover and keyboard focus. Each time it appears, it checks whether there's room above the icon on screen and moves it below the icon if not. It stays open while the icon is still hovered or focused, and Escape closes it.

To check the flip, scroll until the "Due date" row is near the top of the window and hover over the icon; the tooltip should appear below it.
